documentation.content:
The API is serving 5xx responses -- it is answering, and answering wrongly. This is #751's definition of an outage.

No threshold tuning is needed because 5xx should sit at zero; the `duration` is what distinguishes a sustained fault from a single blip. 4xx is deliberately NOT here: those are the API's normal contract, and every anonymous visit to a public page produces a 401 by design.

Runbook: docs/engineering/operations/DEPLOYMENT_RUNBOOK.md#api-returning-5xx
